summary.text: Angela Plowhead is the Republican and Libertarian candidate for the Oregon State Senate, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Deb Patterson. She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Plowhead previously sought the Republican nomination for Oregon's 6th Congressional District in the May 17, 2022 primary, where she finished fourth with 13.2 percent of the vote in a field won by Mike Erickson.
